digest.component_or_area: reconciler Jira-family vendor-adapter seam / ADR set
propositions: A new ADR 0055 must amend (not replace) ADR 0035 to record the jira_family sub-seam, its two parameterizing contracts, the shared-jira provenance decision, the pycontribs/jira extra, and the Data Center time horizon.

The Backend port under-declares what the core requires: TicketTransport declares six members while the core reaches for twenty-one distinct transport members and twelve are absent from the DC transport and declared on no Protocol.

An under-declared, untyped port made a DC reconcile pass crash on set_entity_property at runtime while isinstance checks, the backend contract suite, and 1636 unit tests all passed, showing 'the contract suite certifies a backend' is conditional on the port being complete and typed.

RemoteRef.instance is never constructed in production code (only two test helpers), so the ADR must present deployment-distinguishing as intended design with the gap named and ticketed, not as existing reality.

ADR 0035's 'first real second backend is out of scope' claim is stale in multiple sites (layout diagram comment, prose, Decision item 6, and a Consequences line) and all must be corrected because Jira Data Center landed ahead of the reserved GitHub adapter.

docs/user-guide.md and docs/architecture.md must document the DC backend selection, the jira-datacenter extra, least-privilege PAT scoping, allow_insecure, ca_bundle, and resolved_statuses, with harness-executed evidence requiring a native amd64 CI runner.
